description:
You are going on annual leave and need to ensure your tasks are covered. Configure an Out-of-Office delegation in your User Profile.

Target Delegate: Sally Acm (sally-acm)
Duration: Starting today, ending 7 days from now.

Steps:
1. Open your User Profile / Preferences (top right menu)
2. Find the 'Delegations' or 'Out of Office' section
3. Add a new delegate rule for 'Sally Acm' (sally-acm)
4. Set the Start Date to today and End Date to one week from now
5. Save the configuration
